Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of LLY.
We delivered record revenue of $29.5 billion this quarter, representing 10% year-over-year growth.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 69 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2019.
Our gross margin expanded by 69 basis points to 37.6%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $29.5 billion this quarter, representing 10% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
